ability.name: Misty Surge
ability.note: This Ability is only valid on your turn. This Pokémon can MP move past non-Fairy-type Pokémon on the field. When this Pokémon is on the field, whenever your Water-type Pokémon move from the bench, they may only move to a point one step away from an entry point. This ends your turn. Pokémon within two steps of this Pokémon are not affected by new special conditions.

wheel.name: Dazzling Gleam
wheel.note: *Opposing Pokémon adjacent to this Pokémon spin, and if they spin a Gold Attack then they are knocked out.

wheel.name: Muddy Water
wheel.note: The battle opponent and one neighbor Pokémon directly behind it are knocked 1 step back [CTRL NOTE][in a straight line] and gain Wait.

wheel.name: Poni Wish
wheel.note: You may select one opposing Pokémon. If you do, this Pokémon and the selected opposing Pokémon are excluded from the duel.
